versions.subject: feat: new rules and update
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\csvde.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'csvde.exe'
selection_remote:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -f'
filter_import:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -i'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\csvde.exe" OR OriginalFileName="csvde.exe" CommandLine="* -f*" NOT CommandLine="* -i*"
